name: Twisted Sisters
title: Twisted Sisters Full Day
tagline: The bucket-list loop. RM 335, 336, and 337 through the Frio and Nueces canyons.
description: Leave Fredericksburg via TX 16, pick up the three sisters in Medina, and give the day to the canyons. This is the road everyone asks about — package it as a day that actually works from town.
routeLabel: FBG → Kerrville → Medina → Leakey → Camp Wood → home
stops: Lost Maples Country Store, Vanderpool — fuel, snacks, the pause before the hard miles
Bent Rim Grill / Frio Canyon Motorcycle Stop, Leakey — burgers, Frito pie, bike parking
The Hog Pen, RM 336 — BBQ and a beer if the hours line up (Wed / Fri–Sun)
gotchas: Fuel in Medina, Leakey, and Camp Wood. Blind crests, free-range cattle, thin shoulders. The Hog Pen is not daily. This is not a wine-tasting day.

name: Willow City Loop
title: Enchanted Rock + Willow City Loop
tagline: The local classic. FM 965 sweepers, granite, then the 13-mile Willow City ribbon.
timeLabel: Half day, or full with a Llano lunch
description: North on FM 965 to Enchanted Rock, then the Willow City Loop and home via FM 1323 or TX 16. The drive you can do after coffee and still make dinner in town.
routeLabel: FBG → FM 965 → Enchanted Rock → Willow City Loop → home
stops: Breakfast in Fredericksburg before you roll — spin the Restaurant Finder
Enchanted Rock State Natural Area — stretch, granite, photos
Back on Main for lunch, or push north to Cooper's in Llano if you want BBQ as the destination
gotchas: Spring wildflower weekends turn Willow City into a parking lot. Private ranch land — stay on the pavement. Cattle, cattle guards, and low-water crossings.

name: Llano BBQ Run
title: Llano BBQ Run
tagline: Willow City or TX 16 north, then Cooper's. The food is the destination; the road is the excuse.
description: A Hill Country plate worth the tank of gas. Take TX 16 or peel onto Willow City, land in Llano for Cooper's, and roll home before dark.
routeLabel: FBG → TX 16 / Willow City → Llano → home
stops: Cooper's Old Time Pit Bar-B-Que, Llano — the pit stop that justifies the drive
Optional square-side stroll in Llano before the return
Evening pour back in Fredericksburg from the Bar Finder
gotchas: Cooper's lines on weekends. Leave early or eat a late lunch. Confirm hours before you commit the whole day to brisket.

name: Medina Apples
title: Medina Apple Country + 337 Warm-Up
tagline: Pie, cider country, and the friendliest sister. A taste of Twisted Sisters without the full commitment.
description: TX 16 to Kerrville, then Medina for Love Creek / the Apple Store. Continue onto RM 337 toward Vanderpool if the group is up for it — turn around if they are not.
stops: Love Creek Orchards / The Apple Store, Medina — pie and cider
Lost Maples Country Store if you continue west
Kerrville on the way home for a sit-down if the orchard is slammed
gotchas: Orchard hours and seasonal fruit. RM 337 west of Vanderpool ramps up fast. Confirm the Apple Store is open before you sell the day as a pie run.

name: Luckenbach
title: Luckenbach Backroads Afternoon
tagline: Short, pretty, and back in time for a brewery. The convertible cruise.
description: South and southeast farm roads to Luckenbach, home on backroads instead of 290. Proves the finder can do more than canyon-carving.
stops: Luckenbach Texas — the postcard stop, not the technical one
Spin the Bar Finder for a brewery or beer garden once you are back
Skip a two-hour tasting unless this is explicitly a Sunday ramble
gotchas: Weekend tour-bus energy at Luckenbach. Go early or on a weekday.

name: Pedernales Cruise
title: Pedernales River Cruise
tagline: Ranch Road 1 along the river, LBJ country, Hye. Scenic, not spicy.
description: East toward Stonewall, peel onto Ranch Road 1 along the Pedernales, through LBJ country and Hye. A scenic loop for mixed groups who will not enjoy Twisted Sisters.
routeLabel: FBG → Ranch Road 1 → LBJ / Hye → home
stops: LBJ State Park & Historic Site — stretch and a view
Hye — a quick stop, then decide if you want wine-trail traffic or backroads home
Dinner back in Fredericksburg from the Restaurant Finder
gotchas: 290 wine-trail congestion on Saturdays. Ranch Road 1 is the point; 290 is the compromise.

name: Kerrville TX 16
title: Kerrville + TX 16 Connector
tagline: The Hill Country artery. Rolling ranch land, long sight lines, and a river town turnaround.
description: TX 16 south to Kerrville is not the most technical road in the catalog, but it is the one that connects everything else. Use it as a warm-up, a recovery day, or the gateway toward Medina.
stops: Downtown Kerrville / Guadalupe riverfront — stretch and coffee
Optional: keep going to Medina if the group wants more road
Home on 16, or peel onto a farm road if traffic piles up
gotchas: Weekend traffic between the two towns. This is a cruise, not a canyon. Watch for ranch traffic and left-turn backups.

name: Lost Maples
title: Lost Maples Fall Color
tagline: The seasonal scenic. Vanderpool, Sabinal Canyon, and a country-store pause.
description: When the bigtooth maples turn, this becomes the Hill Country drive people plan weekends around. Same corridor as the sisters, different reason to go — color, not curves.
routeLabel: FBG → Medina → Lost Maples SNA → home
stops: Lost Maples State Natural Area — the color is the destination
Lost Maples Country Store — fuel and a pause
Medina pie on the way out or back
gotchas: Peak color weekends fill the park and the road. Check foliage reports. Summer heat makes this a dawn start for motorcycles.
